observations: White multifunction printer with a paper tray and scanner lid.
The unit is wrapped in clear plastic film.
A large promotional sticker is on the front, featuring the HP logo and text in English and Arabic.
The sticker includes a '1 YEAR WARRANTY' section.
The actual brand name and model number are not legible in the photo.
The printer is shown stacked on another white box or unit.

risks.risk: The actual model and specifications are unknown.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's label (usually on the bottom or back).
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unknown model

risks.risk: The printer may not power on or may have mechanical faults.
risks.proof: A video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.

risks.risk: The internal drum or toner may be missing or degraded.
risks.proof: A photo of the toner cartridge and the internal drum assembly.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the model and serial number label on the bottom or back of the printer.
Photo of the toner cartridge and the internal drum.
Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
